splashet.description: A small, round pup of the shallows that splashes first and thinks later. It likes to leave its Soaked mark on a big foe so everyone else can follow up.

appearance.silhouette: Round water-drop body with a pointed tuft on top and four stubby paws.
features: Big round head that blends into the body like a water drop
One pointed droplet tuft on top of the head
Two large dark eyes with one white highlight each
Stubby flipper-paws with foam-white toes
Cream belly patch
appearance.pose: Sitting upright, head tilted, one paw lifted mid-splash.
always: The droplet tuft on the head
A small puddle or wet footprints beside it
never: Wings or fins on the back

traits: Leaves wet footprints wherever it goes

tidewing.description: Splashet all grown up. Its flippers have stretched into wide, shimmering wings, and it glides over the waves leaving an even bigger splash for its team.

appearance.silhouette: Teardrop body with two wide wing-fins spread like a manta ray and a small tail fin.
features: Droplet tuft on the head, a little longer than before
Large dark eyes with one white highlight each
Two wide translucent wing-fins with pale edge highlights
Small fish-tail fin behind the body
Cream belly patch
appearance.pose: Gliding with both wings fully open, head tilted down toward the viewer.
always: The droplet tuft on the head
Wings clearly wider than the body
never: Paws or legs dangling while it glides

keeps: Round teardrop body and cream belly
changes: Flipper-paws become wide shimmering wing-fins
Gains a small tail fin
Adds a lighter shimmer blue
Longer, taller body

traits: Glides whenever there is a breeze
Still playful, just with a bigger splash
Loves to show off its wings

cindle.description: A kitten-sized cat with a tiny ember at the tip of its tail. It pounces on the boss the moment it spots an opening, and now and then lands a lucky critical hit.

appearance.silhouette: Round kitten with two pointed ears and a short tail ending in a flame.
features: Round head and body, nearly the same width
Two small pointed ears with darker inner tips
Large amber eyes with one white highlight each
Short tail ending in a single flickering ember
Cream muzzle and chest
appearance.pose: Crouched low, rear up, tail flame lifted, ready to pounce.
always: The ember at the tail tip

traits: Warm to the touch and proud of it

pyrelynx.description: A sleek hunter whose fur glows like hot coals when it pounces. It still loves a good chase, but now it waits for the perfect moment to strike.

appearance.silhouette: Lean lynx with tall ear tufts, a long body and a long tail ending in a flame.
features: Longer, leaner body than Cindle
Pointed ears with tall dark tufts
Amber eyes with one white highlight each
Long tail ending in a larger ember flame
Glowing ember-coloured seams along the flanks and legs
appearance.pose: Mid-pounce, front paws stretched forward, tail flame streaming behind.
always: The ember at the tail tip, larger now
never: A full mane or any lion features

changes: Round kitten becomes a lean lynx
Ear tufts grow tall
Glowing coal seams on the flanks
Tail flame is larger

traits: Pounces only when the moment is perfect

sproutle.description: A shy critter with a pair of sprout-shaped ears that naps in sunny patches of moss. It will stand close to its friends and soak up hits for them.

appearance.silhouette: Soft round bean body with two upright leaf-shaped ears and four tiny feet.
features: Round bean-shaped body, slightly wider than tall
Two upright leaf-shaped ears, one with a small curl
Sleepy half-closed dark eyes
Cream belly and muzzle
Tiny stubby feet, barely visible
appearance.pose: Curled up on a patch of moss, ears drooped, one eye half open.

thornbuck.description: A sturdy stag with branching, thorned antlers that shelter the whole herd. It is calm and slow to anger, and very hard to move once it has dug in.

appearance.silhouette: Broad stag body with tall branching antlers and four strong legs.
features: Broad, sturdy deer body on four visible legs
Tall antlers branching in three tines per side, with small thorns
Leaf-shaped ears kept small under the antlers
Calm, half-lidded dark eyes
Cream chest and belly
appearance.pose: Standing square and facing forward, head slightly lowered, antlers up.

changes: Round bean becomes a broad stag
Leaf ears are now small, and antlers grow above them
Four legs clearly visible
Bark brown added to the palette

traits: Slow to anger and hard to move

zipmouse.description: A tiny mouse that crackles with static and never sits still. It zips in first and makes the boss Charged, so your Grove friends can ground it.

appearance.silhouette: Tiny round body with two huge round ears and a zigzag tail.
features: Round body with fluffed fur that sticks out a little
Two oversized round ears with violet inner circles
Tiny black bead eyes with one white highlight each
Tail in a sharp zigzag, like a lightning bolt
Small pale flash-coloured belly
appearance.pose: Mid-scurry, leaning forward, one foot off the ground, tail zigzagging up.
never: Heavy fur outlines or a grumpy look

traits: Gets the zoomies at the slightest excuse

voltaro.description: A fast, fearless runner that leaves a trail of bright sparks. It always wants to be first, and it will race anything that moves for the fun of it.

appearance.silhouette: Lean long-legged mouse with huge ears and a bolt-shaped tail, leaning into a run.
features: Longer legs and a slimmer body than Zipmouse
Two oversized round ears with violet inner circles
Black bead eyes with a white highlight each, set in a confident frown
Tail grown into a larger lightning bolt
A short trail of sparks behind its feet
appearance.pose: Full sprint, body low and leaning forward, sparks trailing behind.
never: A rounder, plumper body than Zipmouse

keeps: Huge round ears with violet inner circles
changes: Round blob becomes a lean sprinter
Longer legs
Larger bolt tail
Adds a trail of sparks

mistnewt.description: A slow, calm newt that carries a soft cloud of mist on its back. It tucks friends into the fog and turns off the boss's adaptation for a few rounds.

appearance.silhouette: Chunky low newt body with a round cloud puff on its back.

One round, fluffy cloud puff on its back, rendered in foam white

Pale fog-blue belly
Four short legs with rounded toes

always: The cloud puff on its back
never: Spikes or crest on the back

fogwyrm.description: A long, quiet serpent that hides entire valleys in thick, cool fog. Its calm is deep, and so is its fog, so the boss loses its tricks for a good while.

appearance.silhouette: Long S-curved serpent body with a cloud mane running down its back.

A cloud mane of foam-white puffs along the spine

Short rounded snout and two short blunt horns
Lighter fog-blue belly with pale scales

always: The cloud puffs on its back

changes: Chunky newt becomes a long serpent
Single puff becomes a full cloud mane
Gains two short horns
Fills the whole frame

traits: Drifts through valleys without a sound

ashmole.description: A busy little digger that warms its burrow with glowing ash and invites everyone in. It cheers on the whole team so they hit a little harder.

appearance.silhouette: Round mole body with a pointed snout and two large shovel paws held out front.
features: Round plump body in warm brown and ash grey
Pointed pink snout
Two large shovel paws with pale claws
Tiny closed or squinting eyes
Orange ember specks scattered over the shoulders
appearance.pose: Standing upright, shovel paws held up, a little ash puff at its feet.
never: Large, round, wide-open eyes (they stay tiny)

traits: Cheerful even when covered in ash

magmole.description: A heavy digger that carves tunnels through stone with molten claws and keeps the whole burrow toasty. It is gentle, but very stubborn.

features: Broader, heavier body than Ashmole
Cracked rocky plates over the back, with magma seams between them

Two huge claws glowing orange and yellow
Tiny squinting eyes

always: Cracked rock plating with glowing seams
never: A round, soft ash coat like Ashmole's

changes: Soft ash fur becomes cracked rock plates
Paws become large molten claws
Bigger, broader body
Gains a darker basalt colour

traits: Loves a good hard day's work

stormray.description: A ray that rides the very edge of thunderclouds. It is bold and a little showy, and it strikes hard and fast with a bolt of its own.

appearance.silhouette: Flat diamond-shaped body with two wide pointed wings and a bolt-shaped tail.
features: Wide diamond body that is wider than it is tall
Two pointed wing-fins with a pale yellow edge
Violet back with a lighter yellow belly
Two small, sharp white eyes with a yellow glint
Thin tail ending in a bolt

Fast to strike, slow to sulk

tempestray.description: A vast ray whose wingbeats stir up whole lightning storms. It is calm in the eye of its own thunder, and it hits harder than any other Spark creature.

appearance.silhouette: Huge diamond body with long swept wings and swirling cloud wisps and bolts around it.
features: Wider and longer wings than Stormray, reaching the frame edges
Violet back with a pale yellow belly
Calm white eyes with a yellow glint
Thicker tail with a large bolt at the tip
Curling cloud wisps and a few bolts around the wing tips

always: Cloud wisps at the wing tips

keeps: White eyes with a yellow glint
changes: Much larger and wider
Cloud wisps and bolts circle the wings
Thicker tail with a bigger bolt
Adds a lilac cloud colour

traits: Calm in the eye of a storm
Commands the sky with lazy wingbeats
Attracts storm clouds wherever it goes

mossback.description: A patient turtle with a small garden growing on its shell. It plants a mark on the boss for friends to build on and keeps its own side of the line tidy.

features: Round dome shell in mossy green with a darker rim
A small tuft of grass and one tiny pink flower on top

always: The garden growing on its shell
never: A tall tree on its shell

ancientshell.description: An ancient turtle whose shell has become a small, living forest. It remembers everything, forgives most things, and it plants a mark on the boss while shielding its own row.

Vines hanging down the side of the shell

changes: Small garden becomes a miniature forest
Shell is taller and has bark rings
Hanging vines
Much larger

traits: Hosts small creatures in its forest
Remembers everything and forgives most things
Rarely makes a sound, and always kindly

coralynx.description: A reef-dwelling lynx with a crown of bright coral. It is elegant and a little proud, and it strikes from the shadows with a lance of coral.

appearance.silhouette: Slender lynx body with tall, branching coral growing from its head like a crown.

Bright eyes with a white highlight each

solmane.description: A lion with a mane of living sunlight that warms everyone nearby. It is warm-hearted and regal, and it leaves a Scorched mark on the boss as it leads from the front.

appearance.silhouette: Large lion body with a huge rayed sun-like mane around its head.

Loves to lead from the front

gaiadrake.description: A mountain-sized drake that carries forests and rivers along its back. It is ancient and gentle, slow to move, and very hard to stop when it roars.

appearance.silhouette: Huge, low drake body with a ridge of trees and a thin river down its back.
features: Wide, heavy drake body in mossy green

aurorix.description: A graceful creature that drifts above the noise, trailing ribbons of aurora light. It watches over the team from a distance and keeps everyone's spirits high.

Tall, pointed ears with yellow tips
Calm, narrow eyes with a white highlight each

lanternfin.description: A round fish with a paper-bright lantern for a tail, seen only on festival nights. It lights the way and lends a hand with a soft, warm glow.

appearance.silhouette: Round fish body with a big glowing lantern in place of its tail.
features: Round, chubby fish body in lantern blue
Large round eyes with one white highlight each
Two small side fins in a paler blue

A tiny golden tassel hanging below the lantern
appearance.pose: Floating upright, tilted slightly toward the viewer, lantern glowing behind.

hearthshell.description: A tortoise that carries a small bonfire on its shell and shows up when a festival begins. It is calm and warm, and happy to share both with the whole team.

appearance.silhouette: Big, broad tortoise with a small bonfire burning on top of its shell.
features: Round terracotta shell with a darker brick rim

Small head with calm dark eyes and a white highlight each
Four thick cream legs
Warm glow on its face from the fire
appearance.pose: Plodding slowly, head forward, bonfire flickering gently.
always: The small bonfire on its shell

sunfawn.description: A gentle fawn whose leaf ears have opened into blossoms. It curls up beside tired friends and lends them the sun it has soaked up all day.

appearance.silhouette: Slender fawn with long legs, two big blossom-tipped ears and a small white-spotted back.
features: Slender, gentle fawn body on four thin legs

ohmouse.description: A round, puffed-up mouse whose giant ears catch stray bolts before they reach its friends. It plants its feet, fizzes, and will not budge.

Wide-set short feet planted flat on the ground
Stubborn black bead eyes under a small frown

Catches stray bolts in its ears
Can freeze like a statue when asked nicely

geyserpup.description: A sturdy pup whose droplet tuft has grown into a tall spout. It saves up every splash it ever made and lets them all go at the boss in one great burst.

Makes its own puddle, so none is a surprise
Its spout hiccups when it is excited
Still first to say hello, now with a fountain

wickat.description: A kitten-sized cat whose ember has settled into a tall, steady flame, like a lit wick. It touches the boss with it first, so the whole team has something warm to follow up.

features: Round head and body, nearly the same width, like Cindle
Two small ears with dark plum inner tips
A tall flame in two layers, orange outside and yellow inside, on a short dark wick

No longer jumps at its own sparks
Lights the way for slower friends
Purrs a little louder by candlelight

drizzlewt.description: A slow, calm newt whose mist has gathered into a small rain cloud. It drizzles on tired friends, and the boss's tricks wash away like footprints in the rain.

features: Wide, low newt body with a short, thick tail

kilnmole.description: A broad mole in a dome of baked clay, with a small chimney on top that glows like a banked fire. It digs in at the door of the burrow and keeps the heat in for everyone behind it.

Slow to move, slower to give way

halcyray.description: A calm ray that glides in just after the storm has passed, trailing a small rainbow. It lends its friends the bright, clear feeling of the sky after thunder.

Calm eyes under a small rainbow arc of lilac and mint

bloomback.description: A patient turtle whose little garden has opened into one enormous flower. It has been saving its bloom since it was small, and when it opens, the boss feels it.

mudlump.description: A squat lump of wet peat with a calm face. It takes its time, takes the hits, and never takes offence.

bogwarden.description: A broad, steady warden of the bog, with cattails on its head and tar on its arms. Whatever strikes it gets a little stuck.

squelch.description: A small ochre frog that squelches when it walks and hums when it thinks nobody listens. Its croak makes big foes feel slow and heavy.

croakmire.description: A big, patient frog with a lily pad on its head and a throat like a drum. One low croak and the boss sinks a little deeper into the mud.
